name: Sarajevo in a day
description_md:
Sarajevo in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk anchored in Sarajevo, BA. This route connects the city's main sights.

The walk requires 10.5 km of walking between stops. There are 6 sightseeing stops along the route. The full day takes about 7.3 hours, which includes the visit time at each stop.
